question: what NMT models did they compare with?

evidence: We first briefly introduce the RNN based Neural Machine Translation (RNN-based NMT) model. The RNN-based NMT with attention mechanism BIBREF0 has achieved remarkable performance on many translation tasks. It consists of encoder and decoder part.
Recently, the Transformer model BIBREF4 has made remarkable progress in machine translation. This model contains a multi-head self-attention encoder and a multi-head self-attention decoder.

title: Ancient-Modern Chinese Translation with a Large Training Dataset
answer_rationale: Text 1 explicitly mentions comparing translation results with 'the other two NMT models (RNN-based NMT and Transformer)' and Text 9 confirms training and testing the 'Transformer-NMT' model. Text 4 and Text 3 also reference comparing SMT with 'various NMT models' including RNN-based NMT and Transformer.
